main_body: deciduous tree with spherical green canopy and brown trunk
top_band: light green top canopy crown on rows 1-14
evidence: The tree canopy has a top-lit upper volume (rows 1-14) and lower overlapping foliage clumps (rows 15-29) that overhang and cast a dark eave shadow (rows 27-30) onto the vertical trunk (rows 30-45).

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference trees, the candidate has a continuous, uniform near-black outline (#090b08) around both the canopy and trunk creating a sticker look. The canopy is a single smooth lollipop ball with pillowed blobs rather than distinct leaf clusters, and the trunk is a straight cylinder with a completely flat base line rather than organic roots and branches.
